item.title: California canceled thousands of trucking licenses. One community bore the brunt of the hit
item.description: A third of California truck drivers are believed to be Sikh, members of a religious group that hails from India. They're hurting after a mass cancellation of commercial driver’s licenses.

item.title: Child care in California was already hard to find — the immigration crackdown has made it worse
item.description: In California, almost 40% of the workforce is foreign-born and more than a million parents — immigrant and otherwise — rely on child care providers so they can go to work.

item.title: California Rep. David Valadao voted for Medi-Cal cuts. Will voters hold it against him?
item.description: In the seven times he’s run for Congress, Valadao has lost his seat only once – in 2018, during Donald Trump’s first midterm election. Democrats hope to oust him again by leveraging his politically toxic vote for the GOP megabill that will cut funding to Medi-Cal, which provides health coverage for nearly two-thirds of his constituents.

item.title: Billionaires aren’t going to flee California. Others will without a budget fix
item.description: The idea that billionaires will flee California over a proposed wealth tax is bunk. Still, the ballot initiative is only a Band-Aid, and impedes a more serious conversation about the state's deeper fiscal problems.
